labels.org.opencontainers.image.description: Modrinth App is a unique, open source launcher that allows you to play your favorite mods, and keep them up to date, all in one neat little package.
labels.org.opencontainers.image.title: Modrinth

dockerfile.amd64:
FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-selkies:ubunturesolute

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG MODRINTH_VERSION
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="thelamer"

# title
ENV TITLE=Modrinth \
    PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=true

RUN \
  echo "**** add icon ****" && \
  curl -o \
    /usr/share/selkies/www/icon.png \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linuxserver/docker-templates/master/linuxserver.io/img/modrinth-logo.png && \
  echo "**** install packages ****" && \
  apt-get update && \
  apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    gnome-keyring && \
  if [ -z ${MODRINTH_VERSION+x} ]; then \
    MODRINTH_VERSION=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/modrinth/code/releases/latest" \
    | jq -r '.tag_name'); \
  fi && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/modrinth.deb -L \
    "https://launcher-files.modrinth.com/versions/$(echo ${MODRINTH_VERSION}| sed 's/^v//g')/linux/Modrinth%20App_$(echo ${MODRINTH_VERSION}| sed 's/^v//g')_amd64.deb" && \
  apt-get install -y \
    /tmp/modrinth.deb && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apt-get autoclean && \
  rm -rf \
    /config/.cache \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/tmp/* \
    /tmp/*

# add local files
COPY /root /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 3001
VOLUME /config

notes.upstream:
## Changed

- File drop areas, such as in the Skin selector, now highlight while dragging and show a spinner while files process.
- Updated translations. Want to help translate Modrinth App? [Click here](https://translate.modrinth.com/)
- Depends on filter styling for app.
- **Modrinth Hosting:** Updated translations. Want to help translate Modrinth Hosting? [Click here](https://translate.modrinth.com/)
- **Modrinth Hosting:** When resubscribing to a Modrinth Hosting server, it will now let you switch payment method and preview the tax (if any) that you will be additionally charged.

## Removed

- Removed "Verify and restore" action from the Resources tab of app settings.

## Fixed

- Fixed Minecraft 1.8.9 failing to launch on Apple Silicon Macs.
- Fixed Modrinth App slowing down or stalling while installing or updating large amounts of content.
- Fixed files dragged into Modrinth App dropping onto the wrong area on macOS and Linux with display scaling.
- Improved loading speed of the Versions page for projects that support many game versions.
- Fixed searchable dropdowns flickering while typing. Selecting the arrow icon now opens and closes the dropdown.
- Fixed instance name sort to also be alphanumerical instead of only alphabetical.
- Fixed issue where you cannot open an instance with track pad.
- Fixed drag to resize slider is to handle multiple jump back in columns.
- Padded bottom of search filters in sidebar since last item can be covered by "Upgrade to Modrinth+" link.
- **Modrinth Hosting:** Fixed the Created and Created by columns being too narrow in the backup history table on the Backups tab.
- **Modrinth Hosting:** Depends on search filter opened below, where it can be covered by app ad box.

## Added

- **Modrinth Hosting:** You can now use the icon editor to create an icon for your server in the General settings tab of the server panel settings modal.
